GRAN OPORTUNIDAD ALFA MADRID NORTE GESTIONA EN EXCLUSIVA EN CALLE PRINCIPAL este magnifico local funcionando de espectacular fachada y muy luminoso con salida de humos a comprobar en excelente ubicación en Las Tablas. MUY BUENAS CONDICIONES Y TRASPASO NEGOCIABLE SE ESCUCHAN OFERTAS RAZONABLES con respuesta rápida. Se encuentra muy cerca de la central de BBVA y rodeado de empresas y de edificios con altísima ocupación residencial, Las Tablas destaca y se ha dado a conocer por su gran ambiente de familias con niños de perfil socio económico medio alto y la entrada y salida de miles de trabajadores de empresas como Telefonica, Mapfre, BBVA, Tele 5, Huawei,.. . El local se encuentra en una calle principal, en la entrada las tablas y con actividad comercial en toda la manzana. Fianza 2 meses, Garantia adicional negociable. inv.desc_en: REF. 1338/281. GREAT OPPORTUNITY. ALFA MADRID NORTE EXCLUSIVELY MANAGES this magnificent, fully operational premises on a main street, featuring a spectacular facade and excellent natural light, with a smoke vent (to be verified), in an excellent location in Las Tablas. VERY GOOD CONDITIONS AND NEGOTIABLE TRANSFER FEE; REASONABLE OFFERS WILL BE CONSIDERED with a quick response. It is located very close to the BBVA headquarters and surrounded by companies and buildings with very high residential occupancy. Las Tablas stands out and has become known for its great atmosphere of families with children of a medium-high socioeconomic profile, as well as the influx of thousands of employees from companies such as Telefonica, Mapfre, BBVA, Tele 5, Huawei, etc. Due to all the above, the hospitality sector is the most prominent in Las Tablas; with good management and a business model covering both on-site service and Take Away/Delivery, it can operate every day with local workers and families, and on weekends with families. The premises are located on a main street at the entrance to Las Tablas, with commercial activity throughout the block. 2-month deposit, additional guarantee negotiable. TRANSFER FEE 60,000 EUROS NEGOTIABLE; OFFERS WILL BE CONSIDERED with a quick response, and a rent of €2,600 + VAT per month with a TEN-YEAR contract for the new tenant/assignee, subject to annual CPI adjustment, with only the first year being mandatory. Agency fees for the tenant/assignee are one month + VAT. The real estate agency is not responsible for possible typographical or data errors; this advertisement is not binding and may be subject to change. Any verification of licenses, installations, dimensions, and contracts will be the responsibility of the interested party with their architect and advisor, with any documentation provided by the transferring party or the owner being made available to them. Viewing is recommended, and discretion is requested regarding staff and customers. The real estate agency exclusively provides intermediation so that the parties can reach the best possible agreement; it does not provide legal, tax, urban planning, labor, or commercial advice, which will be the responsibility of the parties. For more information, please contact us by phone during business hours from Monday to Saturday, 9 a. m. to 9 p. m. , or by email 24/7. Thank you.
